HostDeviceInfo.label: HostDeviceInfo
HostDeviceInfo.description: This LWM2M Object provides a range of host device related information which can be queried by the LWM2M Server. The host device is any integrated device with an embedded cellular radio module.

Host_Device_Manufacturer.label: Host Device Manufacturer
Host_Device_Manufacturer.description: Human readable host device manufacturer name.

Host_Device_Model_Number.label: Host Device Model Number
Host_Device_Model_Number.description: A host device model identifier (manufacturer specified string).

Host_Device_Unique_ID.label: Host Device Unique ID
Host_Device_Unique_ID.description: The host device unique ID as assigned by an OEM, MNO, or other as the Device ID in the onboarding or manufacturing process.

Host_Device_Software_Version.label: Host Device Software Version
Host_Device_Software_Version.description: Current software version of the host device (manufacturer specified string).
